reader.notes: The detail-group and elementary halves are enforced at 85, but the 85 arm drops the COLUMN condition on the strength of Table 1 rows 3 and 4 (COLUMN 'P', GI 'P'). Table 1 lists combinations clause by clause; §1985:XIII.3.13.3 SR1 adds that the entry must define a printable item, and the glossary makes COLUMN NUMBER part of that definition. The binder already reads the same pattern this way for USAGE (SR8 a is applied as stricter than Table 1's USAGE 'P' cells), so GROUP INDICATE has been given a looser reading than its sibling rule.

reader.known_note: none records it as a defect. kb/Work PB5243 (landed) created this 85 arm: it treats 'the legal SOURCE with ... GROUP INDICATE and no COLUMN' as legal on Table 1 alone, and its refusal of that shape was what it removed. A fix would reverse that part of PB5243 for GROUP INDICATE (the JUSTIFIED/BLANK WHEN ZERO half is unaffected).
